catalogIssues.issue: The fix's deviceCheck for results-home-under-statusbar asks to see the rating count after a surrender win and loss. When the surrender or abandonment comes before the winner's first move, the server leaves the rating unchanged ('הדירוג לא השתנה: היציאה הייתה לפני המהלך הראשון שלך'), so there is nothing to count. Step 3 of this task already requires a digit from each phone. The deviceChecks for the rating card should say the same.

phoneState: Both phones are on Home after a relaunch, APK 18 (1.1.0). I ran adb.ts reset on both: font scale 1.0, animations 1/1/1, colour correction off, airplane off. wm size is 1080x2340 and density 450 on both, the system locale is he-IL, and the app language was never changed. P3's sound setting is ON again (it was ON at the start; I turned it OFF only for the sound-off runs). No screenrecord or uiautomator is left running on the phones, and no helper loop is left on the PC. Account side effects from the test games: P1 (אורי) lost about 9 ranked games to stealth bots. Its fast rating went from 1104 (1114 after the rated abandon win) to about 1021, its normal rating from 1206 to 1173, and its league shows ברונזה now (it was כסף). P3 (אחוותא) went 965 → 955 in fast.
